The plate is roughly square, about 330 px across. If it's a side plate of about 22 cm, the scale is about 15 px per cm. The pear measures about 135 px wide and 130 px tall, so it's roughly 9 cm by 8.5 cm. That is a fairly round pear, perhaps 8 cm in diameter and 9 cm long when viewed from above. Its volume is about 4/3·π·4·4·4.5 ≈ 300 cm³. At a density of about 0.95 this gives roughly 250 g. A typical pear weighs 180–200 g, so I'll estimate about 200 g.
